issues.issue: Is the certified question dispositive of the appeal?
issues.applicant_position: Question is dispositive of the appeal because it affects the appellant's right to remain.
issues.result_quote: It follows that the certified question is purely academic in nature; the answer to the question will not affect the legal rights of the parties to this appeal.

issues.issue: Can the Appeal Division's failure to order a stay of removal make the certified question dispositive?
issues.applicant_position: Appeal Division could have stayed the removal order under s. 68(1), giving a meaningful remedy.
issues.result_quote: this issue cannot give rise to a certified question that is dispositive of this appeal.
